rationale: The first reply correctly identified E011 as a held-key detection and gave a safe power-cycle step, but it did not ask about wetness or cleaning, and it also mentioned a temperature-feedback alternative the case does not support. It also steered the customer toward a stuck button or a panel fault, and suggested pressing every button, which is mildly off target. The second reply linked the spray residue to the code, gave sensible cleaning advice and escalated only if the code recurs, with no part recommended.
